about: MICRO-SEG02 (E.D., 20 Nov 2026) · THE ONE PLACE where a command says what a script may give it. em.app.commands.run(id, **params) checks the params against this table (script-commands.ts), the console completes from it (it reaches the bridge with the session), and the reference pages of docs-api are generated from it (gen_commands.py). Like Blender's operators: a command whose values are all there runs WITHOUT its window (EXEC_DEFAULT); with values missing it opens its window, filled with what was given (INVOKE_DEFAULT). 'form': exec = runs with no window; invoke = opens its window (pre-filled), and runs without it when the values in 'exec_when' are given; window = a window a person answers, no script form yet ('why' says what is missing); none = not from a script ('why'). Param types: str, int, float, bool, list[str], enum (with 'choices'). Docs are English (the reference's language), like Python docstrings.

updates.doc: Ask whether a newer EMStudio exists (desktop).

updatesHelp.doc: Ask whether a newer EMStudio exists (Help menu, Windows and Linux).

workspaces.doc: Show the window that says what each workspace is for.

pythonApi.doc: Open this reference in the browser.

new.doc: A new empty document. The script goes on reading the document it started on (``g``); the next run sees the new one.

newProject.why: asks where the folders of a new EM project go and how they are named: a person's answer, no script form yet
newProject.doc: Make the folders of a new EM project.

open.doc: Open an em.json (or a GraphML, through the importer). With ``path`` no file picker opens; the question about unsaved work is still asked.

params.name: replace
params.doc: close the open files first (asking for their unsaved work), as the box «Replace the open files»

openReplace.doc: Open a file in place of the open ones (= ``open`` with ``replace=True``).

openProject.why: a project is a folder chosen in the folder picker; no script form yet (open its em.json with ``open``)

save.doc: Save the active document where it is. A graph that has no file yet asks where (Save As).

saveAs.doc: Save the active document under another name. With ``path`` no save picker opens: the file is written there (over a file already there) and becomes the document's file.

params.name: path
params.doc: where to write the em.json (absolute path)

saveAll.doc: Save every file with unsaved work.

pin.doc: Pin a version of the project: a snapshot downloaded beside the work.

bringIn.doc: Bring files or a folder into the document. With ``paths`` the window of the three choices does not open: ``mode`` says which road (as ``door``).
bringIn.returns: how many files or folders were given

params.name: paths
params.doc: the files, or one folder (absolute paths)

params.name: mode
params.doc: files: the files themselves; folder: a folder read by a reader of folders; dosco: a folder read as DosCo

params.name: date
params.doc: the date of the document the files make (the door's field)

params.name: epoch
params.doc: the epoch a model is placed in (id)

params.name: confirm
params.doc: press the door's OK: the files come in with what the door proposes (refused, the door stays open for a person)

door.doc: The door: files into the document. With ``paths`` no file picker opens and the door opens with them; with ``confirm=True`` (and ``date`` when the door wants one) its OK is pressed and no window stays open.
door.returns: how many files or folders were given

params.name: mode
params.doc: files: the files themselves; folder: each path a folder read by a reader of folders; dosco: a folder read as DosCo

params.name: date
params.doc: the date of the document the files make (the door's field)

params.name: epoch
params.doc: the epoch a model is placed in (id)

params.name: confirm
params.doc: press the door's OK (refused, the door stays open for a person)

doorFolder.doc: A folder (a stack of slices) to a reader of folders, or read as DosCo.

doorDosco.doc: Read a folder as DosCo: each file with an EM id becomes the document of that id. With ``path`` the folder picker does not open; the door shows what it found.

integrate.why: chooses, graph by graph, what of another file comes in: a person's choice, no script form yet
integrate.doc: Integrate another file into this one (Blender's Append).

importGraphml.doc: Import a yEd GraphML (through s3Dgraphy's importer). With ``path`` neither the picker nor the question of the em.json's name opens: the graph stays without a file until ``saveAs(path=…)``.

importMapping.why: a table and its mapping are chosen and checked in the mapping editor; no script form yet (s3Dgraphy's importers are reachable from Python directly)
importMapping.doc: Import a table with a mapping.

exportSvg.doc: The graph window's drawing as SVG. Without ``path`` it is downloaded; with ``path`` it is written there.

exportTtl.doc: The RDF/CIDOC projection as Turtle (s3Dgraphy). Without ``path``: the save picker on the desktop, a download on the web; with ``path`` it is written there.

composeFromGraph.why: the .blend is composed in a window that chooses epochs, versions and Blender: no script form yet
composeFromGraph.doc: A Blender scene (.blend) composed from the graph.

consolidate.why: opens Archive › Assets, where the target is chosen: no script form yet

printSheets.why: the sheets, their scope and the printer are chosen in the print window: no script form yet

relocate.doc: Find missing files. With ``folder`` there is no folder picker and no window: the search's tally comes back; with ``apply=True`` the paths found without doubt are rewritten (the ambiguous ones stay for a person, in the window).

params.name: apply
params.doc: rewrite the paths found without doubt

collect.why: says what will be copied where and asks: a person's answer, no script form yet
collect.doc: Collect the resources beside the project.

revealDoc.doc: Open the project folder in the system's file manager.

cleanFile.why: says what the presentation section holds before taking it out: a person's answer
cleanFile.doc: Take the presentation section out of the file.

reorderProject.why: shows the moves before doing them: a person's answer
reorderProject.doc: Reorder the project by the standard.

createRoom.why: a room is made on a node with a name and an invitation: a person's answer

bringIntoRoom.why: a room is made on a node with a name and an invitation: a person's answer
bringIntoRoom.doc: Bring this into a new room.

close.doc: Close the active document (asking for its unsaved work).

closeProject.doc: Close the project (asking for unsaved work).

quitFile.why: quitting the application from a script would end the script's own session

georef.why: the card of each graph's system is answered in its window: no script form yet

addNode.doc: A new node of ``type`` in the active graph window (the Matrix places it in ``epoch``'s lane). One undo step.

params.name: type
params.doc: the node type (US, USVs, document, property…)

params.name: name
params.doc: its name (default: the next free one)

addUnitAbove.doc: A new unit ABOVE ``of`` (the new one is later: new is_after of), as «US above X» of the add menu. One undo step.

params.name: of
params.doc: the unit it sits on (id or name)

params.name: name
params.doc: its name (default: the next free one)

addUnitBelow.doc: A new unit BELOW ``of`` (the new one is earlier: of is_after new). One undo step.

params.name: of
params.doc: the unit above it (id or name)

params.name: name
params.doc: its name (default: the next free one)

connect.doc: Connect two nodes, as the drag from a node's handle: ``edge_type`` default is the first the datamodel allows between their types (is_after for two units). One undo step.

params.name: edge_type
params.doc: the EM relation (default: the datamodel's first)

moveToEpoch.doc: Move units to an epoch, as dropping them in its lane: the epoch they were in is left. One undo step per unit.

extendToEpoch.doc: Units that also survive into an epoch (the epochs they are in are kept).

fold.doc: Fold a group (its members hidden in it).

enterGroup.doc: Enter a group (the double click): the canvas shows its inside.

leaveGroup.doc: Leave the group the canvas is in (Esc).

frameNode.doc: Centre the graph window on a node and select it (a jump: ``back`` returns).

fit.doc: Fit the graph in the window (0, ⇧C).

back.doc: Back to the view before the last jump (⌘[).

deleteNodes.doc: Delete nodes, as ⌫ on the selection (one undo step; the toast gives them back).

params.name: ids
params.doc: the nodes (ids or names); default: the selection

nudge.doc: Nudge the selection by screen pixels (the arrows).

reflow.doc: Rearrange (Disponi): the nodes given, or the whole Matrix.

params.name: ids
params.doc: the nodes to rearrange; default: all

layoutFresh.doc: Recompute the layout from scratch (⌥ + Arrange): the manual arrangement is dropped.

compact.doc: Compact the Matrix (the units closer, the order kept).

magnify.doc: Magnify a window to the whole workspace, or put it back (⌃Space).

params.name: window
params.doc: the window id (em.app.windows); default: the active one

spaceView.doc: An aligned view of the Space (the numeric keypad).

spaceFrameSelected.doc: Frame the selection in the Space (. or F).

spaceCursorReset.doc: The 3D cursor to the median of what is drawn, and the view on most of it (⇧C).

where.why: opens the chip's menu, which a person reads: a script reads the author and the node through em

search.why: the search field is typed by a person: a script searches the graph with ``g`` (em.graph)

pan.why: a pure gesture of the pointer: a script moves the view with frameNode or em.app.space.set_camera

panMiddle.why: a pure gesture of the pointer: a script moves the view with frameNode

wheel.why: a pure gesture (zoom at the pointer): a script zooms with zoomIn / zoomOut

click.why: a pure gesture: a script selects with em.app.select

multi.why: a pure gesture: a script selects several with em.app.select

marquee.why: a pure gesture: a script selects with em.app.select

detach.why: a drag out of a container: a script removes the membership edge with em.write

dragEsc.why: puts back what is being dragged: there is no drag in a script

rclick.why: opens a menu a person reads: its items are commands and actions of this list

laneMenu.why: opens a menu a person reads: reflow, a new epoch (em.write), the chronology check

longPress.why: the add menu on touch: a script uses addNode

s3pick.why: a pure gesture in the Space: a script asks a point with em.app.space.pick

s3pickRm.why: a pure gesture in the Space: a script reads the models with em.app.space.layers

s3menu.why: opens a menu a person reads

s3dbl.why: a pure gesture (the centre of rotation under the cursor): a script sets the camera with em.app.space.set_camera

s3box.why: waits for a rectangle drawn by a person

s3cursor.why: a pure gesture (the 3D cursor on the surface under the pointer)

s3wheel.why: a pure gesture: a script sets the camera with em.app.space.set_camera

s3orbit.why: a pure gesture: a script sets the camera with em.app.space.set_camera

s3pan.why: a pure gesture: a script sets the camera with em.app.space.set_camera

s3rightDrag.why: a pure gesture: a script sets the camera with em.app.space.set_camera

s3zoomDrag.why: a pure gesture: a script sets the camera with em.app.space.set_camera

s3boxSel.why: a pure gesture: a script selects with em.app.select

s3emul3.why: a setting of the mouse, not an act

s3np0.why: the camera view: the Space has no camera object yet

s3sidebar.why: opens a panel a person reads: a script reads the cursor and the camera through em.app.space

s3outliner.why: opens a panel: a script opens windows with em.app.windows.open

s3add.why: a base shape is placed with the 3D cursor by a person; no script form yet

s3grs.why: a modal transform driven by the pointer; a model's placement is written with em.write

s3axisPlane.why: a key inside the modal transform (G R S)

s3snap.why: a key inside the modal transform (G R S)

s3parent.why: no script form yet: the parent is an edge written with em.write

s3delete.why: no script form yet: a proxy is removed with em.write

s3shiftClick.why: a pure gesture: a script selects with em.app.select

s3selectAll.why: the Space's own selection of objects is not reachable from Python yet: em.app.select selects nodes

s3selectNone.why: the Space's own selection of objects is not reachable from Python yet: em.app.select([]) clears the nodes'

s3boxSelect.why: waits for a rectangle drawn by a person

s3hide.why: hides the selected objects: a script hides a layer with em.app.space.layers (visible)

s3reveal.why: reveals the hidden objects: a script shows a layer with em.app.space.layers (visible)

s3hideUnselected.why: hides the others: a script hides layers with em.app.space.layers (visible)

toolEsc.why: a key of the tracing tool, driven by the pointer

polyClose.why: a key of the tracing tool, driven by the pointer

polyFirst.why: a gesture of the tracing tool

bubbleArrows.why: keys of a suggestion bubble a person reads

corner.why: a pure gesture of the windows: a script opens windows with em.app.windows.open

divider.why: a pure gesture of the windows (the size of the areas)

tabDbl.why: renames a workspace: a person's word

tabMenu.why: opens a menu a person reads

storagePick.why: a pure gesture in the File window

folderClick.why: a pure gesture in the File window

fieldEnter.why: a key of a text field

fieldTab.why: a key of a text field

proseSlash.why: a key of the narrative's text

proseLink.why: a key of the narrative's text
